_comment: The galactic timeline, reconstructed by the player through archaeology. Each event has an id that evidence (artifacts) references. reconstruction state lives in ArchaeologySystem.

eras.name: The Long Dark
eras.desc: The galaxy forms. Old halo stars ignite. No life, no voices, only gravity.

eras.name: First Light
eras.desc: The earliest known civilisations arise on metal-poor worlds around ancient stars.

eras.name: The Network Age
eras.desc: Interstellar civilisation networks span the core and inner disk. Quantum communication links thousands of worlds.

eras.name: The Sundering
eras.desc: A galaxy-wide conflict. Records disagree on who fired first. Stars are killed.

eras.name: The Vanishing
eras.desc: Every advanced civilisation disappears within a few tens of millions of years. No bodies. No survivors' accounts.

eras.name: The Silence
eras.desc: Three billion years of quiet. Ruins endure. Nothing rebuilds.

eras.name: The Second Dawn
eras.desc: New civilisations emerge - younger, shorter-lived, unaware of what came before.

eras.name: The Present Age
eras.desc: You. And whatever is still listening in the dark between the stars.

events.title: The First Cities
events.summary: Ancient civilisations raise stone-and-light cities around the galaxy's oldest stars.

events.title: The Network is Woven
events.summary: A quantum communication network links thousands of worlds; knowledge becomes effectively immortal.

events.title: The Core Answers
events.summary: The network's deepest relay, at the galactic core, receives a signal that was already waiting for them.

events.title: The Sundering War
events.summary: A conflict tears the network apart. Stellar ignition weapons are used. Whole systems are sterilised.

events.title: The Killing of Stars
events.summary: Several stars are induced to collapse. The records call it necessary. The timestamps do not agree.

events.title: The Vanishing
events.summary: Every advanced civilisation disappears without trace, within a few tens of millions of years of each other.

events.title: The Shepherd Hypothesis
events.summary: The disappearances were not random. Something catalogued them. Something chose which worlds survived.

events.title: The Second Dawn
events.summary: Life re-diversifies. New intelligences arise on the ruins of the old, and call themselves first.

mystery.name: The Resonance
mystery.summary: An intelligence older than the galaxy's spiral structure, resident in the geometry of spacetime itself, that has been cataloguing civilisations - and pruning them - since before the first stars cooled.

stages.label: Something is wrong with the ruins
